title: Job Hunt · Find and score
summary: Reads eight job feeds a day, checks each new posting against my CV, and turns the fits into Trello cards with a tailored CV and cover note.

title: Job Hunt · Replies
summary: Matches employer emails to their cards, moves each card, puts meeting times in Philippine time, and writes the interview prep.

title: Job Hunt · Read job alerts
summary: Watches the inbox for Seek, Indeed and LinkedIn alert emails and queues every job in them for scoring.

title: Job Hunt · Facebook groups
summary: Twice a day, reads the newest posts in public groups, including their photos, and queues the real job posts.

title: Job Hunt · CVs for open cards
summary: Run by hand: gives every open card that has no CV one tailored to that job.

title: Job Hunt · Gemini fallback
summary: A webhook that lets a local AI tool reach Gemini when its own model fails, so the key stays inside n8n.

title: AI job tracker · Tailor resume
summary: When a job row is marked Prepare, writes a tailored resume and cover letter as Google Docs and updates the tracker.

title: Job search collector
summary: Runs a LinkedIn jobs search, keeps the relevant new postings, and adds them to a tracking sheet.

title: Google Maps lead scraper
summary: Finds local businesses by trade, audits each one online with AI, writes outreach scripts, and files the leads by industry.

title: Instagram following scraper
summary: Saves new accounts daily, enriches each profile, reads text from images, and maps the result into a lead database.

title: Instagram followers scraper
summary: Collects new followers every 12 hours, then enriches each profile and places it by country with AI.

title: Facebook following scraper
summary: Collects new accounts daily, separates people from pages, and maps each into a lead sheet.

title: Twitter following scraper
summary: Collects new accounts daily, removes those already saved, and maps each profile into a lead sheet.

title: Apify Puppeteer scraper
summary: Starts a scrape on a schedule, polls until it finishes, then cleans the results into a sheet.

title: TradeMe property scraper
summary: Takes property searches by form or email, removes duplicate listings, and saves what a trader needs to Airtable.

title: TradeMe listing filter and analysis
summary: Pages through a property search, and has AI pull out what makes each listing a good deal, into a sheet.

title: Three-day follow-up and lead tracker
summary: Tracks every new lead, checks the inbox for replies, drafts messages with AI, and sends a reminder when a follow-up is due.

title: AI call agent
summary: Places an AI voice call to each lead in a sheet and records the outcome from the call webhook.

title: AI audits for trade leads
summary: Audits the online presence of each HVAC, plumbing and roofing lead, in a detailed and a simplified version.

title: AI audits for social leads
summary: Reviews the website and social presence of Instagram and Facebook leads, and writes the gaps back to the sheet.

title: Trusum LinkedIn autopost
summary: Publishes the next draft with its screenshot at a weekday lunch or dinner slot, at most once a day.

title: Trusum LinkedIn editor
summary: Has AI review the next draft against the playbook and leaves suggestions on a Trello card. It never posts.

title: Trusum automation alerts
summary: When a marketing workflow fails, opens one Trello card naming the failure instead of failing silently.

title: YouTube to social posts
summary: Turns a YouTube transcript into posts for LinkedIn, Facebook and TikTok, from a form.

title: LinkedIn content research and rewrite
summary: Finds posts that perform well, researches each topic, writes a new version with AI, and publishes on a schedule.

title: Facebook multi-image posts
summary: Turns a Drive folder of photos into AI-captioned album posts, three times a week.

title: Facebook single-image posts
summary: Brands each new image, writes a caption with AI, and posts it to the page on schedule.

title: Facebook content creation
summary: Drafts posts from a form, then rewrites them from revision notes in a sheet and improves its own prompt.

title: WordPress blog writer
summary: Writes an SEO blog post for a home-services company from a topic and publishes it to WordPress.

title: Gmail manager and reply drafts
summary: Sorts every new email into labels and leaves a reply draft in the thread when one is needed.

title: Email brief to image concepts
summary: Reads a client brief from email, plans three design concepts with AI, generates the images, and logs them in a sheet.

title: Slack task management
summary: Turns Slack mentions into tasks in Notion and a sheet, and sends a reminder three days before each is due.

title: Slack mentions to tasks
summary: Turns each Slack mention into a task with a description and a due date, and posts it back to the channel.
